classification.difficultyReason: Combine quadrilateral angle sums, parallel-line relationships and an exterior angle.

content.prompt: Find the values of the pronumerals in these diagrams.

spec.description: Trapezium ABCD; matching single parallel arrows on BC and AD; right-angle square at D.

answer.worked:
Co-interior angles on parallel lines $BC$ and $AD$ are supplementary.
$$\begin{align*}\alpha+90^\circ&=180^\circ\\\alpha&=90^\circ\\\beta+65^\circ&=180^\circ\\\beta&=115^\circ\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Convex ABCD with no side markings.
spec.answerVisibility: Both unknown angles remain labelled α.

spec.description: Parallelogram PQRS. Matching single arrows on QR and PS; matching double arrows on PQ and SR.
spec.mathematics: P=62°, Q=α, R=β, S=γ; both pairs of opposite sides are parallel.

answer.worked:
Use supplementary co-interior angles on the marked parallel sides.
$$\begin{align*}\alpha+62^\circ&=180^\circ\\\alpha&=118^\circ\\\gamma+62^\circ&=180^\circ\\\gamma&=118^\circ\\\beta+118^\circ&=180^\circ\\\beta&=62^\circ\end{align*}$$

spec.description: ABCD with AD extended right beyond D. C has a right-angle square. α is outside the quadrilateral at D.
spec.mathematics: A=70°, B=110°, C=90°; α is supplementary to interior angle ADC.

answer.worked:
The interior angles of $ABCD$ sum to $360^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}\angle ADC+70^\circ+110^\circ+90^\circ&=360^\circ\\\angle ADC&=90^\circ\end{align*}$$
The interior and exterior angles at $D$ form a straight angle.
$$\begin{align*}\alpha+90^\circ&=180^\circ\\\alpha&=90^\circ\end{align*}$$
